title: Where a Travis County tax bill goes
subtitle: Shares of a homeowner's bill, on the 2026 figures Central Health cites
alt: Bar chart of the share of a Travis County homeowner's property tax bill going to each taxing entity on 2026 figures: 44.1 percent to Austin Independent School District, 25.6 percent to the city of Austin, 18.3 percent to Travis County, 6.2 percent to Austin Community College and about 6 percent to Central Health, the county hospital district
